query: SELECT json_build_object('temporary_grade_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_grades WHERE comment='Test transactionnel Commande 10.1'),'grade_count_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_grades),'verified_a_coefficients',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('A1','A2') AND c.is_verified),'physics_coefficients',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('A1','A2') AND s.name ILIKE '%Physique%'),'a2_profiles',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE school_level='Terminale' AND series='A2')) AS audit LIMIT 1;
